The file in this folder is from the octoglow project (https://github.com/slomkowski/octoglow) and is licensed with the MIT license. It is `software/octoglowd/src/test/resources/proc-net-route/2.txt` at commit 1418ff7, unmodified, and only used as input data for unit tests. It is the routing table of a host whose default route is on `br0`, with a `tun0` tunnel interface for `10.9.0.0/24` (the project doesn't say which VPN created it).
